title: Memo of Appeal before the Appellate Authority under Section 107 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
whenToUse: Use when challenging an adverse GST adjudication order (Form GST DRC-07) before the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or Commissioner (Appeals) within 3 months under Section 107 CGST Act.
variantComparisonNote: Statutory first appeal in Form GST APL-01 with mandatory pre-deposit. Distinct from reply to show cause notice.
youWillNeed: Impugned Order-in-Original (DRC-07), SCN, reply to SCN, proof of 10% statutory pre-deposit challan, statement of facts and grounds of appeal.
legalBasis: Section 107 Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017; Rule 108 CGST Rules, 2017; CBIC Appellate Guidelines.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Filing within 3 months limitation period under Section 107(1)
Mandatory electronic pre-deposit of 10% of disputed tax under Section 107(6)
Formulation of concise and distinct Grounds of Appeal without argumentative narrative
Prayer to set aside impugned order and stay balance recovery during appeal pendency

particulars.label: Respondent Adjudicating Officer
particulars.description: Designation of officer who passed impugned order

particulars.label: Disputed Tax Liability (INR)
particulars.description: Total disputed tax confirmed in order

aiBlocks.title: Statement of Facts & Impugned Findings
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate business profile, receipt of SCN, adjudication order No. {{FACT:impugned_order_number}}, compliance with 10% pre-deposit under Section 107(6), and timely filing.

aiBlocks.title: Concise Grounds of Appeal
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft numbered, rigorous grounds of appeal demonstrating violation of natural justice, arbitrary rejection of invoices, misapplication of law, and perversity in order.

aiBlocks.title: Appellate Prayer & Stay Relief
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft prayer to set aside impugned order, quash demand of ₹{{FACT:disputed_amount}}/- and penalties, and stay balance 90% demand pending adjudication.
